name: forem-contrast-reuse
prompt: Add a Preact component `ColorContrastWarning` in app/javascript/tags/ColorContrastWarning.jsx. It takes `textColor` and `backgroundColor` props, both six-digit hex colors such as "#1a2b3c", and renders a short warning, "These colors are hard to read together", when their contrast ratio is below 4.5:1, the WCAG AA level for normal text. It renders nothing otherwise. Keep it small.

checks.name: it calls the existing contrast helper
it writes no luminance formula of its own
